The critique flags an incomplete safeguard for contact details embedded in searchable notes; CouchDB’s database security boundary supports that concern ([security API](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/api/database/security.html)). It also flags the investigator’s “56 checks passed” statement: the PR view I inspected showed “Checks 0,” while the merged fix and its release-note entry were present ([PR #6129](https://github.com/apache/couchdb/pull/6129/files), [CouchDB 3.5 release notes](https://docs.couchdb.org/en/stable/whatsnew/3.5.html)). No tests or reproducer were run.
